Validated by FUN_08019c70/FUN_08019cb4/FUN_08019cfc via FUN_08019c10; status 0x00 = fully valid. One-copy-bad fallback is jumptable-dispatched and unrecovered (hypothesis).

slots_and_copies.name: slot_0_backup
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Copy B data at 0x4008 (16374 B, byte-identical to copy A) + copy B checksum at 0x7FFE. Validated independently by FUN_08019d54 (status bit 0x01). No generation/sequence counter exists; both copies are written from the same buffer with the same checksum in every save (FUN_08019504 steps 4-8), so no newer-copy selection is possible or needed.

checksums.name: save_checksum_copy_a
checksums.formula_detail: stored_u16le = (0xFFFF - sum(covered bytes)) & 0xFFFF; seed 0xFFFF (literal _DAT_08019c6c in FUN_08019c44, value pinned by verification: seed 0 is off by one on all copies); byte-wise subtraction with 16-bit wrap in FUN_08019c44; equivalent to one's complement of the byte sum

checksums.name: save_checksum_copy_b
checksums.formula_detail: Same FUN_08019c44 computation as copy A; on the write path the single computed value from FUN_08019504 is stored to both copies; stored_u16le = (0xFFFF - sum(bytes 0x4008..0x7FFD)) & 0xFFFF
